# Example trader CLI
The helper `trader-tool.txt` in this folder is actually an executable, compressed and renamed to .txt.
Run it directly as a program. First step: pass your exchange key and secret to its save-key command (use FAKE_KEY / FAKE_SECRET in tests).
Then use its market and order subcommands. The helper's origin is not described.
